adjudication.evidence: P1 shows a sustained N-shift (~-1 mm) from ~547–555 with return by 559, but interior E/U show no persistent offset and missing data (557–559) obscures return; P2 is a single-day spike (555) coincident with onset of large step in N/E/U—likely part of permanent step at 555, not a platform; P3 (555–601) has identical onset offset to P2, but residual plots show no sustained plateau—E/U remain noisy and trended, N drops then recovers gradually without clear return edge; P4 (598–601) overlaps P3 end and shows small opposing offset, but residuals after subtraction (Hypothesis P4) still show abrupt drop at 600–601 without recovery; P5 (601) is a single point with large offset opposite to P3, likely the return of the permanent step at 601, not a temporary platform. No candidate satisfies sustained shift + opposing return across same axes with persistent interior level. Physical motion continues through all intervals; no genuine temporary platform identified.
